responsibility: This option-definition file declares the H8/300 target-specific command-line switches and maps them to backend masks and properties. It owns CPU-selection options such as -mh/-ms/-msx, ABI and data-layout choices like -mint32 and -malign-300, code-generation toggles such as -mquickcall, -mrelax, and monitor/EXR behavior flags, providing the option table that drives target_flags and later hook decisions in the backend.
same_name_distinction: Unlike h8300.cc, h8300.h, and h8300.md, this file does not implement code generation or describe instructions; it is the generated-options input that declares H8-specific -m switches and maps them to target masks/flags that the rest of the backend consumes.
